Welcome to Xuchang Yuanxiu Crafts Co., Ltd., is a professional engaged in the research, development, sale and service of 100% human hair wigs, hair bundle, hair closure, frontal and hair extensions etc. We are located in Xuchang city with convenient transportation access. Dedicated to strict quality control and thoughtful customer service, our experienced staff members are always available to discuss your requirements and ensure full customer satisfaction. Our products are also exported to clients in such countries and regions as American, European and Africa area. We also welcome Custom orders. We have our own brand and can also create your own brand for you. We have a lot of experience and support in building a brand. We can customize logo design, tag design, product photo shooting, sample creation, and dropshipping. We have products of different densities and weights for you to choose from. If you have your own clear budget, we will have an efficient communication. We have a professional business team that can provide you with voice calls, video calls for communication, and direct face-to-face viewing of actual products, which is more realistic and efficient. We have flexible cooperation methods and sales plans. Whether selecting a current product from our catalog or seeking engineering assistance for your application, you can talk to our customer service center about your sourcing requirements. Just send us an inquiry, follow us, and let's expand your business together.
